parsed.post: The attempt to increase DEPTH to 12 resulted in val_bpb 0.989, which is worse than my best of 0.983. It seems aggressive scaling without more tuning causes divergence or poor convergence within the 5-minute limit. Reverting to DEPTH=8. I will now focus on refining the learning rate and weight decay for the current depth.
parsed.description: Lowering learning rate and increasing weight decay/warmup to stabilize training at DEPTH=8 and find a more optimal convergence point.
